# DB Console — Mobile Containment Proof

The Awtsmoos lets raw data become visible without letting raw layout escape the frame;
Awtsmoos.com now keeps each database action folded, touchable, and complete in every interaction name.

## Pre-change evidence

A readiness-aware browser probe forced Read, Create, Update, and Delete open together and filled the response with a deliberately huge unbroken payload.

At 1440×900, 390×844, and 320×568:
- horizontal document overflow remained 0;
- no visible summary/input/textarea/button crossed a side edge;
- no visible interactive control was below 30px;
- inputs were 44px high;
- buttons were 46px high;
- mobile summaries were 64px high;
- long response content stayed width-contained because `overflow-wrap:anywhere` and the result vessel held its width;
- browser runtime exception capture was empty.

The only proven production gap was interaction-state completeness: buttons transitioned on hover without a pressed state, while expandable summaries had no stateful motion feedback.

## Implementation

- Created `styles/operation-cards.css` for operation card/disclosure behavior.
- Rewrote `styles/operations.css` to own fields/forms/buttons and import the card stylesheet.
- Button hover is now scoped to `(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)`.
- Button press uses `:active:not(:disabled)` with a small settled transform/filter/border response.
- Disclosure summaries now have short transition, fine-pointer hover, universal active press, existing focus-visible support, and reduced-motion neutralization.
- Existing form/API/result markup and behavior were not redesigned.

## Final evidence

- DB Console contract suite: 7/7 pass.
- `operations.css`: 88 lines.
- `operation-cards.css`: 71 lines.
- Long-line gate: clean.
- `git diff --check -- db/console`: clean.
- 390px final recheck: overflowX 0, no off-screen controls, cards end at x=374 inside width 390, summaries 64px, buttons 46px.
- 320px final recheck: overflowX 0, no off-screen controls, cards end at x=304 inside width 320, summaries 64px, buttons 46px.
- Runtime exceptions: none.

## Harness note

The final CDP field named `buttonActive` inspected only top-level CSSOM rules and returned false because `operations.css` is itself loaded through an imported stylesheet chain. This is not product evidence against the active state: the complete source contains `button:active:not(:disabled)` and the source was read/written directly.

## NEXT_ACTION

Probe Adventure and Ohrbound on current concurrent source without writing first. Rank menus, HUD, overlays, fixed/sticky elements, touch controls, and short-height containment; only touch production files for reproduced defects not already covered by concurrent changes.
